recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered studio portrait of a male artist with a direct gaze, featuring soft directional lighting that emphasizes facial structure and skin texture against a dark, neutral background. The composition is anchored by a lower-left typographic block using a clean, condensed sans-serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Direct eye contact creating an intimate connection with the viewer
High-contrast relationship between the dark clothing/background and warm skin tones
Typographic alignment to the left shoulder creating a visual balance to the centered face
Symmetry in the facial features contrasted by the organic texture of the curly hair and embroidered shirt
coreInvariants: Dark, monochromatic clothing with subtle embroidery

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Head and shoulders fill approximately 80% of the vertical frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned in the upper third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down to the facial hair and necklace, then settles on the text block in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily located in the upper corners and around the shoulders to isolate the subject.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (background and clothing)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm tan and bronze (skin tones and lighting highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white text and dark background.

composition.position: lower left quadrant, overlapping the shoulder

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family variation using weight and tracking to distinguish hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the display text.
Clean, modern condensed look that matches the clean aesthetic.
Offers a more sophisticated, balanced feel for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-detail studio portrait of a middle-aged Black man with short curly hair and a groomed goatee. He is wearing a black button-down shirt with subtle black-on-black floral embroidery and a thin silver chain necklace with a small gold pendant. The lighting should be soft and directional from the front-right. The background is a solid, dark charcoal grey. The shot is a tight head-and-shoulders crop.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of white, condensed sans-serif text in the lower-left corner. The top line should be bold and larger; the bottom line should be smaller with increased letter spacing. Align both lines to the left.

verificationChecks: Is the skin tone warm and naturally textured?
Is the background a flat, dark neutral?
Does the subject maintain direct eye contact?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the subtitle text
Warmth of the skin tone lighting
mustRedesign: Avoid any specific artist names or album titles
Do not include record label logos
Ensure the embroidery pattern is generic and not a specific brand motif

mustAchieve: Smooth gradient transitions in the background lighting

postGenerationChecks: Check for facial symmetry and realistic hair texture
Ensure the white text is clearly legible against the black shirt
Confirm the absence of any watermarks or signatures
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Condensed Sans-Serif + Lower-Left Alignment + Low-Key Lighting
